protocol: Primary transfer: all sorted multisets of explicitly demanded evidence types are absent from training and calibration. No same incident, no delexicalized near-duplicate across partitions. All paraphrases about an incident remain in the same partition. Frozen training, metric, release and baselines. Report counts, all outcomes, per-question changes versus seed, paired family outcomes, unquoted subset and reused receipt indices. Small authored panel, not an external benchmark.
